name: provenance
description: Use this skill when a task asks about a node's history: what changed in a node, when, or who changed it; whether a person's typing in the node counts as a change and whose name it carries; why some entries read and return no data and take no time; how a failed run looks; or asks to bring back earlier code. It says what a node's history holds, the runs and edits in it, the entries typing and an agent's change make, how to read and compare entries, and that putting an entry back is the user's action.
